groom.name: Riju
groom.parents: Son of Mr and Mrs Basumatary

bride.name: Anjali
bride.parents: Daughter of Mr and Mrs Narzary

blessing: With the blessings of Bathou Bwrai
welcome: With the blessings of our elders and before the sacred Bathou, we invite you to share the day our two families become one. Come in your brightest dokhona and gamsa, and celebrate with us.

events.title: Hathasuni Haba
events.subtitle: The wedding before the Bathou
events.note: The bride serves the first meal of rice and ondlakhari to the groom and to every guest.

events.title: Reception
events.subtitle: Music, Bagurumba and dinner
events.note: The kham and siphung play from sunset.

dressCode.what: Dokhona with jwmgra. Gwmw yellow, green or any bright colour you love.
Gamsa with khot gosla, or festive formal wear.
An aronai will be placed around your neck when you arrive.

story: We met at a Bwisagu celebration in Kokrajhar, both pretending not to watch the other dance. Seven springs later, we are asking our families and friends to stand with us before the Bathou.

timeline.title: First meal
timeline.text: Rice and ondlakhari served by the bride

timeline.title: Dinner
timeline.text: Under the lamps at Riverside Garden

travel.title: Getting there
travel.text: Kokrajhar railway station is 4 km away. Rupsi airport is the closest airport, about 40 minutes by car.

travel.title: Transport
travel.text: Our cars wait at the station on the morning of the wedding. Call Dwimalu on 98640 21573 to be picked up.

travel.title: Where to stay
travel.text: We have held rooms at the Hotel Bodoland Inn and the Gaurang Riverside Lodge. Mention our names when you book.

gift: Your presence is our gift. If you would like to bless us further, a small box for envelopes will be beside the Bathou.
